subject: Biology
title: Cell Theory
summary: Your body has about 37 trillion cells. Three scientists showed that every living thing is built from cells, and every cell comes from another cell.
keyPoints: **All living organisms are made of one or more cells** (Schleiden 1838, Schwann 1839).
**The cell is the basic structural and functional unit of life.**
**All cells arise from pre-existing cells** (Virchow 1855, "Omnis cellula e cellula").
Exception: **viruses** are not made of cells.

blocks.caption: From cork (1665) to the cell theory (1838-1855).

blocks.p: In **1838** the botanist **Matthias Schleiden** concluded that all **plants** are made of cells. In **1839** the zoologist **Theodor Schwann** found the same for **animals** and called the cell the basic unit of life. In **1855** **Rudolf Virchow** added the missing piece: new cells come only from the division of existing cells.

blocks.alt: The three postulates of the cell theory
blocks.caption: The cell theory in three lines.

blocks.alt: One cell dividing into 2, 4 and more
blocks.caption: Postulate 3: after n divisions, 2^n cells.
Different in detail, both cells: one theory covers both.

blocks.p: **Limits:** viruses are acellular, and the theory does not explain how the very first cell formed.

quiz.q: Who proposed that all cells arise from pre-existing cells?
Which of these does NOT fit the cell theory?
quiz.explain: Viruses are not made of cells (acellular).
Schleiden (a botanist) studied plants in 1838; Schwann (a zoologist) studied animals in 1839.

quiz.q: A bacterium divides every 20 minutes. Starting from one, how many after 2 hours?

simulation.reason: The postulates are historical conclusions; the timeline, postulate chart and cell-division diagram carry them. The only quantitative idea (2^n doubling) is worked in the quiz.
